summary: StoneX Group Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a three-for-two stock split via a stock dividend. The board approved the split to broaden accessibility for employees and investors. Each stockholder of record on July 7, 2026, receives one additional share for every two owned, distributed after July 17, 2026; cash is paid for fractional shares. Trading on a split-adjusted basis begins July 20, 2026. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
